/* ================= HELPERS ================= */
function $(s, c){ return (c||document).querySelector(s); }
function $$(s, c){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((c||document).querySelectorAll(s)); }
function fmtCr(n){ return "₹" + (Math.round(n*100)/100).toString().replace(/\.0+$/,"") + " Cr"; }
function fmtINR(n){ return "₹" + Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-IN"); }
function refCode(prefix){ var s=""; var c="ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"; for(var i=0;i<5;i++) s+=c[Math.floor(Math.random()*c.length)]; return prefix+"-"+s; }
var toastT;
function toast(msg){ var t=$("#toast"); t.textContent=msg; t.classList.add("show"); clearTimeout(toastT); toastT=setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove("show")},3400); }

/* ================= ICONS ================= */
var IC = {
 bed:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 18v-6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v6M3 18h18M3 21v-3M21 21v-3M6 10V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/></svg>',
 bath:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 12h16v2a5 5 0 0 1-5 5H9a5 5 0 0 1-5-5v-2zM6 12V6a2 2 0 0 1 4 0M7 21l-1 1M17 21l1 1"/></svg>',
 area:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4h16v16H4zM4 9h5M15 20v-5"/></svg>',
 pin:'<svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#B89A5E" stroke-width="1.7"><path d="M12 21s-7-5.6-7-11a7 7 0 0 1 14 0c0 5.4-7 11-7 11z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.6"/></svg>',
 heart:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20.7C6.4 17 3 13.6 3 9.9 3 7.2 5 5 7.6 5c1.7 0 3.4.9 4.4 2.4C13 5.9 14.7 5 16.4 5 19 5 21 7.2 21 9.9c0 3.7-3.4 7.1-9 10.8z"/></svg>'
};

/* ================= SHORTLIST ================= */
var shortlist = {};
function shortlistIds(){ return Object.keys(shortlist); }
function syncShortlist(){
  var n = shortlistIds().length, c = $("#shortlistCount");
  c.hidden = n===0; c.textContent = n;
  $$(".heart").forEach(function(h){ h.classList.toggle("on", !!shortlist[h.getAttribute("data-heart")]); });
  var dl = $("#drawerList");
  if(!dl) return; /* drawer not built yet — it is created on first open */
  if(n===0){ dl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--ink-soft);padding:16px 0">No homes shortlisted yet. Tap the heart on any home and it will wait for you here.</p>'; return; }
  dl.innerHTML = shortlistIds().map(function(id){ var p = byId(id); return '<div class="di"><img src="'+p.img+'" alt="" /><div><b>'+p.name+'</b><span>'+p.area+', '+p.city+' · '+fmtCr(p.price)+'</span></div><button data-unheart="'+id+'" aria-label="Remove '+p.name+' from shortlist">×</button></div>'; }).join("");
  $$("[data-unheart]", dl).forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener("click", function(){ toggleHeart(b.getAttribute("data-unheart")); }); });
}
function toggleHeart(id){
  var p = byId(id);
  if(shortlist[id]){ delete shortlist[id]; toast(p.name+" removed from your shortlist."); }
  else { shortlist[id]=true; toast(p.name+" added to your shortlist."); }
  syncShortlist();
}
function byId(id){ for(var i=0;i<PROPS.length;i++) if(PROPS[i].id===id) return PROPS[i]; return PROPS[0]; }

/* ================= CARDS ================= */
function cardHTML(p){
  return '<article class="pcard rv in">'
   + '<div class="ph" data-cursor="View" data-open="'+p.id+'"><img src="'+p.img+'" alt="'+p.name+' — '+p.area+', '+p.city+'" loading="lazy" /><span class="tag">'+p.tag+'</span>'
   + '<button class="heart" data-heart="'+p.id+'" aria-label="Shortlist '+p.name+'">'+IC.heart+'</button></div>'
   + '<div class="bd"><div class="price">'+fmtCr(p.price)+'</div>'
   + '<h3 data-open="'+p.id+'">'+p.name+'</h3>'
   + '<p class="loc">'+IC.pin+' '+p.area+', '+p.city+'</p>'
   + '<div class="specs"><span>'+IC.bed+' '+p.beds+' Bed</span><span>'+IC.bath+' '+p.baths+' Bath</span><span>'+IC.area+' '+p.sqft.toLocaleString("en-IN")+' sq ft</span></div>'
   + '<div class="ft"><button class="btn line small" data-open="'+p.id+'">View Home</button></div>'
   + '</div></article>';
}
function bindCards(scope){
  $$("[data-open]", scope).forEach(function(el){ el.addEventListener("click", function(e){ if(e.target.closest(".heart")) return; openDetail(el.getAttribute("data-open")); }); });
  $$("[data-heart]", scope).forEach(function(h){ h.addEventListener("click", function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); toggleHeart(h.getAttribute("data-heart")); }); });
}
$("#featuredGrid").innerHTML = PROPS.filter(function(p){return p.featured;}).map(cardHTML).join("");
bindCards($("#featuredGrid"));

/* ================= FILTERS ================= */
function applyFilters(){
  var city=$("#fCity").value, bud=$("#fBudget").value, beds=$("#fBeds").value, type=$("#fType").value, q=($("#fSearch").value||"").toLowerCase();
  var out = PROPS.filter(function(p){
    if(city && p.city!==city) return false;
    if(type && p.type!==type) return false;
    if(beds && p.beds < parseInt(beds,10)) return false;
    if(bud==="u5" && p.price>=5) return false;
    if(bud==="5to10" && (p.price<5 || p.price>=10)) return false;
    if(bud==="o10" && p.price<10) return false;
    if(q){ var hay=(p.name+" "+p.area+" "+p.city+" "+p.type+" "+p.tag+" "+p.story).toLowerCase(); if(hay.indexOf(q)===-1) return false; }
    return true;
  });
  $("#propGrid").innerHTML = out.map(cardHTML).join("");
  $("#propEmpty").hidden = out.length>0;
  $("#propGrid").style.display = out.length? "" : "none";
  $("#resultCount").innerHTML = "Showing <b>"+out.length+" of "+PROPS.length+" homes</b>" + (city? " in "+city : "") + (out.length? "" : " — try widening the filters.");
  bindCards($("#propGrid")); syncShortlist();
}
["fCity","fBudget","fBeds","fType"].forEach(function(id){ $("#"+id).addEventListener("change", applyFilters); });
$("#fSearch").addEventListener("input", applyFilters);
$("#fReset").addEventListener("click", function(){ ["fCity","fBudget","fBeds","fType"].forEach(function(id){ $("#"+id).value=""; }); $("#fSearch").value=""; applyFilters(); });
applyFilters();

var VIEWS = ["home","properties","detail","services","areas","about","contact"];
function go(view, arg){
  VIEWS.forEach(function(v){ $("#view-"+v).classList.toggle("active", v===view); });
  $$("nav.main button").forEach(function(b){ b.classList.toggle("on", b.getAttribute("data-nav")===view || (view==="detail" && b.getAttribute("data-nav")==="properties")); });
  $("#mobileMenu").classList.remove("open");
  if(view==="areas" && arg){ setTimeout(function(){ var el=$("#guide-"+arg); if(el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth", block:"start"}); }, 80); }
  else window.scrollTo(0,0);
  if(typeof onScroll==="function") onScroll();
  initReveals();
}
document.addEventListener("click", function(e){
  var t = e.target.closest("[data-nav]"); if(!t) return;
  var v = t.getAttribute("data-nav");
  if(t.hasAttribute("data-city-link")){ $("#fCity").value = t.getAttribute("data-city-link"); applyFilters(); }
  if(t.id==="drawerCta"){ closeDrawer(); }
  e.preventDefault(); go(v, t.getAttribute("data-city"));
});
$$(".city-card").forEach(function(c){ c.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){ if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){ e.preventDefault(); go("areas", c.getAttribute("data-city")); } }); });

/* ================= FORM VALIDATION ================= */
function validField(id){
  var el=$("#"+id), v=(el.value||"").trim(), ok=true;
  if(id==="vName"||id==="eName") ok = v.replace(/[^A-Za-z ]/g,"").length>=3;
  else if(id==="vPhone"||id==="ePhone"){ var d=v.replace(/\D/g,""); if(d.length===12 && d.indexOf("91")===0) d=d.slice(2); if(d.length===11 && d.charAt(0)==="0") d=d.slice(1); ok = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(d); }
  else if(id==="vDate"){ if(!v) ok=false; else { var today=new Date(); today.setHours(0,0,0,0); ok = new Date(v+"T00:00:00")>=today; } }
  else if(id==="eMsg") ok = v.length>=10;
  else ok = v.length>0;
  el.closest(".fld").classList.toggle("bad", !ok);
  return ok;
}
function wireForm(sel, ids, onOk){
  var form=$(sel); if(!form) return;
  ids.forEach(function(id){ var el=$("#"+id); el.addEventListener("blur", function(){ validField(id); }); el.addEventListener("input", function(){ el.closest(".fld").classList.remove("bad"); }); });
  form.addEventListener("submit", function(e){ e.preventDefault(); var all=ids.map(validField); if(all.indexOf(false)===-1) onOk(); else { var bad=form.querySelector(".fld.bad input,.fld.bad select,.fld.bad textarea"); if(bad) bad.focus(); } });
}
wireForm("#enquiryForm", ["eName","ePhone","eBudget","eMsg"], function(){
  $("#enquiryForm").style.display="none"; var s=$("#enquirySuccess"); s.classList.add("show");
  $("#enquiryRef").textContent = refCode("AUR-ENQ");
  toast("Enquiry received — reference "+$("#enquiryRef").textContent);
});

var io;
function initReveals(){
  if(io) io.disconnect();
  io = new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(en){ if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } }); }, {threshold:.12});
  $$(".rv:not(.in)").forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
}
initReveals();
(function(){
  if(!window.matchMedia("(pointer:fine)").matches) return;
  var dot=$("#cursorDot"), ring=$("#cursorRing"), x=0,y=0,rx=0,ry=0;
  document.addEventListener("mousemove", function(e){ x=e.clientX; y=e.clientY; dot.style.left=x+"px"; dot.style.top=y+"px";
    var hot = e.target.closest("a,button,select,input,textarea,summary,.pcard .ph,.city-card,[role='button']");
    var form = e.target.closest("input,textarea,select");
    ring.style.display = form ? "none" : "block"; dot.style.display = form ? "none" : "block";
    ring.classList.toggle("big", !!hot && !form);
  });
  (function loop(){ rx+=(x-rx)*.16; ry+=(y-ry)*.16; if(Math.abs(x-rx)>.1||Math.abs(y-ry)>.1){ ring.style.left=rx+"px"; ring.style.top=ry+"px"; } requestAnimationFrame(loop); })();
})();
syncShortlist();

<script>
/* ================= PREMIUM MOTION LAYER =================
   Desktop-first, fully degradable: no GSAP / reduced motion / touch
   leaves the site exactly as it was, with the signature film looping. */
(function(){
  var REDUCED = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var FINE = window.matchMedia("(pointer: fine)").matches;
  var DESKTOP = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 861px)").matches;
  var sigVideo = document.getElementById("sigVideo");

  /* ---- Horizontal strip: build cards from the same catalogue ---- */
  var track = document.getElementById("htrack");
  if(track && typeof PROPS !== "undefined"){
    track.innerHTML = PROPS.map(function(p){
      return '<article class="hcard" data-cursor="View" data-hopen="'+p.id+'" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="View '+p.name+'">'
        + '<img src="'+p.img+'" alt="'+p.name+' — '+p.area+', '+p.city+'" loading="lazy" />'
        + '<div class="bd"><div class="price">'+fmtCr(p.price)+'</div><h3>'+p.name+'</h3>'
        + '<p class="loc">'+p.area+', '+p.city+' · '+p.beds+' Bed · '+p.sqft.toLocaleString("en-IN")+' sq ft</p></div></article>';
    }).join("");
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(track.querySelectorAll("[data-hopen]"), function(el){
      el.addEventListener("click", function(){ openDetail(el.getAttribute("data-hopen")); });
      el.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){ if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){ e.preventDefault(); openDetail(el.getAttribute("data-hopen")); } });
    });
  }

  /* ---- Reduced motion: no effects at all, film simply loops ---- */
  if(REDUCED){
    if(sigVideo){ sigVideo.setAttribute("autoplay",""); sigVideo.setAttribute("loop",""); sigVideo.muted = true; var rp = sigVideo.play(); if(rp && rp.catch) rp.catch(function(){}); }
    return;
  }

  /* ---- Cursor label disc (desktop, fine pointer) ---- */
  if(FINE){
    var ring = document.getElementById("cursorRing"), label = document.getElementById("cursorLabel");
    document.addEventListener("mousemove", function(e){
      if(!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
      var lab = e.target.closest("[data-cursor]");
      if(lab){ label.textContent = lab.getAttribute("data-cursor"); ring.classList.add("label"); }
      else ring.classList.remove("label");
    });
  }

  if(!window.gsap) { /* libraries blocked: signature film falls back to a loop */
    if(sigVideo){ sigVideo.setAttribute("autoplay",""); sigVideo.setAttribute("loop",""); sigVideo.muted = true; var gp = sigVideo.play(); if(gp && gp.catch) gp.catch(function(){}); }
    return;
  }
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  /* ---- Native scrolling, untouched ----
     No smooth-scroll library, no wheel hijacking, no pinned sections:
     the page scrolls exactly the way the browser scrolls — 1:1 with the
     wheel, trackpad and touch. ScrollTrigger reads the native scroll
     position directly, so nothing sits between the reader and the page. */
  /* keep view-switching honest: re-measure triggers after a view change */
  if(typeof window.go === "function"){
    var _go = window.go;
    window.go = function(v, a){
      _go(v, a);
      setTimeout(function(){ ScrollTrigger.refresh(); }, 140);
    };
  }

  /* ---- Magnetic primary CTAs (desktop) ---- */
  if(FINE){
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".magnetic"), function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener("mousemove", function(e){
        var r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        gsap.to(btn, { x: (e.clientX - r.left - r.width/2)*.32, y: (e.clientY - r.top - r.height/2)*.32, duration: .4, ease: "power3.out" });
      });
      btn.addEventListener("mouseleave", function(){ gsap.to(btn, { x: 0, y: 0, duration: .8, ease: "elastic.out(1,.45)" }); });
    });
  }

  /* ---- Hero entrance + parallax (transform only) ---- */
  gsap.from(".hero .inner > *", { y: 38, opacity: 0, stagger: .09, duration: 1.05, ease: "power3.out", delay: .15, clearProps: "transform" });
  var heroVid = document.querySelector(".hero video");
  if(heroVid){
    gsap.set(heroVid, { scale: 1.16 });
    gsap.to(heroVid, { yPercent: 12, ease: "none", scrollTrigger: { trigger: ".hero", start: "top top", end: "bottom top", scrub: true } });
    /* one decoder at a time: the hero film sleeps while it is off screen,
       so it never competes with the signature film further down the page */
    if("IntersectionObserver" in window){
      new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(en){
        if(en.isIntersecting){ var hp = heroVid.play(); if(hp && hp.catch) hp.catch(function(){}); }
        else heroVid.pause();
      }); }, { threshold: .02 }).observe(heroVid);
    }
  }

  /* ---- Slide-in panels: feature rows slide from opposite sides ---- */
  if(DESKTOP){
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".feat-row"), function(row){
      row.classList.remove("rv"); row.classList.add("in");
      var flip = row.classList.contains("flip");
      gsap.from(row.querySelector(".img"), { x: flip ? 64 : -64, opacity: 0, duration: 1.1, ease: "power3.out", scrollTrigger: { trigger: row, start: "top 80%" } });
      gsap.from(row.querySelector(".txt"), { x: flip ? -64 : 64, opacity: 0, duration: 1.1, delay: .12, ease: "power3.out", scrollTrigger: { trigger: row, start: "top 80%" } });
    });
    /* gentle parallax inside image bands */
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".feat-row .img img, .guide img"), function(img){
      gsap.set(img, { scale: 1.14 });
      gsap.fromTo(img, { yPercent: -5 }, { yPercent: 5, ease: "none", scrollTrigger: { trigger: img, start: "top bottom", end: "bottom top", scrub: true } });
    });
  }

  /* ---- Staggered reveals: process steps + testimonials ---- */
  [[".process > div", ".process"], [".testi", ".testis"], [".svc-card", ".svc"], [".adv", ".adv-grid"]].forEach(function(pair){
    var items = document.querySelectorAll(pair[0]);
    if(!items.length) return;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function(el){ el.classList.remove("rv"); el.classList.add("in"); });
    gsap.from(items, { y: 46, opacity: 0, stagger: .13, duration: .9, ease: "power3.out", clearProps: "transform",
      scrollTrigger: { trigger: pair[1], start: "top 82%" } });
  });

  /* ---- Signature film: a plain looping film ----
     It plays while it is on screen and pauses when it is not. No
     scroll-scrubbing and no seeking, so video decoding never competes
     with scrolling. The brass line under it is the film's own progress. */
  if(sigVideo){
    sigVideo.muted = true;
    var sigBar = document.getElementById("sigProg");
    sigVideo.addEventListener("timeupdate", function(){
      if(sigBar && sigVideo.duration > 0) sigBar.style.width = ((sigVideo.currentTime / sigVideo.duration) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
    });
    if("IntersectionObserver" in window){
      new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(en){
        if(en.isIntersecting){ var sp = sigVideo.play(); if(sp && sp.catch) sp.catch(function(){}); }
        else sigVideo.pause();
      }); }, { threshold: .05 }).observe(sigVideo);
    } else {
      var spf = sigVideo.play(); if(spf && spf.catch) spf.catch(function(){});
    }
  }

  /* ---- "One Sweep" strip: a native sideways scroller ----
     The row scrolls horizontally on its own — swipe on touch, wheel or
     drag on desktop, cards snapping into place. The page's vertical
     scroll is never captured, pinned or converted. */
  if(track){
    var tDown = false, tMoved = false, tStartX = 0, tStartL = 0;
    track.addEventListener("pointerdown", function(e){
      if(e.pointerType !== "mouse" || e.button !== 0) return;
      tDown = true; tMoved = false; tStartX = e.clientX; tStartL = track.scrollLeft;
    });
    track.addEventListener("pointermove", function(e){
      if(!tDown) return;
      var dx = e.clientX - tStartX;
      if(!tMoved && Math.abs(dx) > 6){ tMoved = true; track.classList.add("dragging"); }
      if(tMoved) track.scrollLeft = tStartL - dx;
    });
    ["pointerup", "pointercancel", "pointerleave"].forEach(function(ev){
      track.addEventListener(ev, function(){
        tDown = false;
        if(tMoved) setTimeout(function(){ tMoved = false; track.classList.remove("dragging"); }, 60);
      });
    });
    track.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      if(tMoved || track.classList.contains("dragging")){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }
    }, true);
  }

  window.addEventListener("load", function(){ ScrollTrigger.refresh(); });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
